items.name: host.name
items.description: Hostname for Access Server (IP address or hostname)

items.name: vpn.server.daemon.enable
items.description: If true, enables multi-daemon support, running multiple OpenVPN daemon instances. In multi-daemon mode daemons listen on the dynamic ports dynamic ports pool (see sa.dyn_port). Traffic is balanced between daemons running. If set to false, Access Server runs in single-daemon mode, in this case OpenVPN daemon listens on the single port defined by AS configuration
